title: How to Measure Emergence
outcome: Compute the signed four-cell contrast, positive amount, and valid share.
prerequisites: The mapped chapter and its notation

input_fields.scores: Four finite scores ordered neither,first only,second only,both.
input_fields.budgets: Four nonnegative matched resource budgets in the same order.

equations.label: EQ02-01
explanations: Equation (2.1) asks whether anything is left over after each operation is credited for what it accomplishes alone.
Take the score with both operations, subtract each single-operation score, then add the neither score back once because the subtractions removed it twice.

equations.label: EQ02-02
explanations: Equation (2.2) splits the whole improvement from neither operation to both into three named pieces: what each buys alone, plus what the pair adds.
The left side is the total gain; the first two right-hand terms are the isolated gains; the last term is whatever the pair achieves beyond them.

equations.label: EQ02-03
explanations: Equation (2.3) reports the interaction as a share of the total joint gain, so the size of a contrast can be compared against what was available to win.
Divide the interaction contrast by the whole improvement from neither operation to both.
